name: audit-loose-ends
description: At the end of a substantive task — or when you signal end-of-session — reconcile your durable records (memories, project notes, reminders, task list, and the waypoints store) so nothing is left redundant, orphaned, or falsely flagged as to-do when it's already done. A SessionStart nudge + a skill with the procedure. Companion to waypoints; sibling to resume-interrupted, no-hidden-changes, measure-twice.
